limits: Rust symbols are kept only when their mangled path names the producing crate (this includes core/alloc generics instantiated over that crate's own types). Native objects are attributed to the -sys crate whose build produced them, including C++ template and COMDAT code (e.g. libstdc++ containers) compiled in RocksDB translation units.
symbol is one representative name; candidate_symbols lists every identical-body name and candidate_versions every version that builds the same body.
A match identifies the crate and confirms the candidate version reproduces that body; it does not prove the whole crate version, features or the node build profile.
Generic code monomorphized inside node crates, private forks and crates that did not build at the candidate versions are not covered.
Relocation fields are masked, not resolved. No first-party component credit.
